description.value: Sushi Town is a Japanese sushi restaurant on Marine Drive in North Vancouver serving authentic Japanese cuisine with indoor seating. It sits on a busy commercial corridor convenient to cyclists on the North Shore. Online ordering and takeout are available for riders who prefer to grab a meal on the go.

address.value: 1227 Marine Dr, North Vancouver, BC V7P 1T3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the business is open, operating at 1227 Marine Dr, North Vancouver, BC V7P 1T3 — providing the full street address absent from OSM. The phone number (604) 984-6155 matches OSM's +1-604-984-6155. The website explicitly promotes online ordering and takeout ('Get your favourite Japanese food to go now!'), but makes no mention of bike parking, Wi-Fi, washrooms, water refill, or any other cycling-relevant amenities.
concerns: OSM addr:postcode-only address field lacks street number and name; full address 1227 Marine Dr confirmed via website.
